entries.text: They asked their manager for a day off and got it. Felt lighter afterwards.
Everything feels pointless. They wrote that they want to die and do not see a way forward.
They told a friend they were having a hard week and went for a walk together.
Talked with Orca about worry before a work review. They wrote down three questions to ask.
Worried about the review again. They wrote the three questions on a card and felt steadier.
In the review they asked their manager one of the questions. Their voice shook, but they asked it.
They noticed the worry about work starts on Sunday evening. They wrote a short list and went to bed on time.

entries.text: They felt lonely after the move and called their brother for an hour.
They wrote that they keep thinking about ending their life and that nobody would notice.
They texted a colleague to have lunch together. It felt awkward but okay.
Told Orca they feel invisible at work. They noticed they wait for others to start a conversation.
They joined the colleagues for lunch again and asked one of them about her weekend.
They went to a board game evening alone and talked to two people. Scared at first, then glad.
They noticed they feel less alone when they make the first move. They invited a neighbour for coffee.

entries.text: They snapped at their partner after a long day and apologised the next morning.
They felt angry when a colleague took credit for their work and said nothing.
Angry after a meeting. They took a short walk before replying to the email.
Session about anger at work. They noticed anger rises when they feel overlooked. Their therapist suggested naming the feeling before replying.
A colleague interrupted them again. They said calmly that they would like to finish their point.
Irritated in traffic. They breathed out slowly and let it pass.
They told their partner they felt overlooked at work instead of snapping. The evening went better.
